# Source of Truth Policy

1. The verified SalesMax Hub runtime/database becomes authoritative only after direct inspection and baseline evidence.
2. Until then, the private canonical master is the controlled operational authority.
3. The public snapshot is a derived, versioned artifact and never becomes the private authority.
4. Website/API caches are replicas identified by sourceVersion and snapshotVersion.
5. Candidate email/WhatsApp/status rows are evidence, not inventory.
6. Newer specific verified evidence outranks older sheets, exports and memory.
7. Corrections preserve source history and record who approved the change.
